verdict.rationale: Greptile is a SaaS code-review platform, so offering official SDKs is a fair question, but the evidence pack never mentions an official SDK library. What it documents is an official CLI (including API-key use for CI), an MCP server, and the greptile.json config. These are adjacent integration surfaces, not SDKs, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
